clips.title: The story
paras: "Remember That I Love You" begins with a torn, stained parchment discovered among the undead-stalked graves in the Ruins of Lordaeron. The letter tells the tragic tale of a lost child belonging to the Heartweaver family. Seeking answers requires carrying this fragile relic south to the orphanage in Stormwind City.

Amid the blighted earth and shambling undead haunting the ruins of Capital City, survivors and scavengers occasionally stumble across reminders of the Third War's devastation. This torn, blood-stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead-trodden grounds of the graveyard. Mentioning a missing child of the Heartweaver lineage, it is a testament to lives shattered when Prince Arthas and the Scourge tore through the kingdom.

With Lordaeron fallen and the Undercity claiming the catacombs below, the few refugees who escaped south scattered across the kingdoms of the Alliance. In Stormwind City, Orphan Matron Nightingale tends to the children who lost their parents to the wars. Delivering the blood-stained letter to her care represents one of the few hopes that a surviving child of the Heartweaver family might be identified and brought closure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What is it, friend? What are you looking for?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh! Little Jeremy Heartweaver. He was brought in years ago after the attack on Lordaeron. Lost both of his parents in the attack, poor thing.
He was actually adopted not too long ago by a sweet woman out in Duskwood.
